prompt: Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo catalog product. Subject: deep traditional grain-carrying basket with woven body and a broad asymmetrical rim; front pouring lip, right side cord handle, rear reinforced tall wall. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size generous within class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable continuous strips and smooth bindings; secondary frames/supports only as specified. Keep natural resting/display pose: mats, trays and sieves flat, upright vessels naturally upright. All interiors empty. CAMERA: straight-on FRONT azimuth zero; upright products center-height, thin horizontal products modest downward elevation showing woven top and shallow front rim. No overhead or three-quarter azimuth. Canonical front for subsequent views. Full product centered with margins, square image, warm-white seamless studio, soft lighting and subtle contact shadow, sharp fiber texture. No props, people, animals, plants, food, room, detached extra objects, border or collage. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, captions, measurements or watermark.
